plan.original_prompt: Write concise natural English listing copy using only confirmed product facts. Keep unknown color, retail pack size and certifications unknown. Do not exaggerate or invent claims.
plan.optimized_prompt:
You are writing a US Amazon listing for a cotton tote bag. Write in natural, concise US English. Use only the confirmed facts in {{PRODUCT_FACTS}}; treat anything not listed there as unknown and do not state, imply, or guess it. Use {{KEYWORDS}} only as candidate keyword ideas: include a keyword only if it is supported by {{PRODUCT_FACTS}}, and drop or flag any keyword that would require an unconfirmed fact.

Deliver these fields: a title, item_highlights, bullet_points (each with a stable ID and text), and a description. Follow the character/byte limits and all applicable rules in the current US rule pack supplied at use time; do not assume any fixed limits. Keep the title readable and front-load the most useful product terms. Make each bullet a distinct, concrete benefit or use case grounded in confirmed facts. Keep the description clear and factual.

Rules:
- Do not invent or imply certifications, eco/green claims, degradation or compostability claims, antimicrobial/health claims, load ratings, durability or performance test results, or any other unverified attribute. If a selling point needs evidence that is not in {{PRODUCT_FACTS}}, omit it.
- Do not include contact information, URLs, prices, availability, shipping offers, or promotional language.
- Do not state a retail pack quantity unless {{PRODUCT_FACTS}} explicitly confirms it; supplier carton or poly-bag quantities are not retail pack counts.
- Keep units and attributes distinct and correct (for example, capacity vs. load, fabric weight vs. unit weight).
- Do not copy specifications or claims from competitor listings; competitor text is only a phrasing reference.
- If a fact needed for a field is missing, leave it out rather than filling the gap.

Return the listing copy only, in English, with no commentary about compliance or approval.

rules.title_zh: 文案中的交易与促销信息

content.item_highlights.note: 本应用保守沿用文案限制，待亮点字段具体规则核实；不作为独立官方规则计数。

rules.repair: 移除文案中的交易与促销信息，专门的售价或库存字段不适用此规则。
rules.note: 促销语这一类只收整短语，不收裸 best / sale / free（20 条真实在售文案里 gift bag 14/20、perfect for 8/20 都是正常卖点）。同义词没有穷举；漏掉的写法由模型语义层兜底，本机无 Key，模型层是否兜得住属于未验证。

rules.repair: 有确定事实则建议按事实修复；无资料则标记 needs_evidence。
标题只保留本变体的件数，其余规格放到变体选项里。
rules.note: 标题并列多种包装规格时提醒确认当前变体的零售件数。项目内部表达建议，不是平台强制规则；不将并列选项自动登记为实际件数。

rules.repair: 建议移除宽泛宣称，或由人工确认支持具体限定表述的证据。
rules.note: 关键词仅用于召回；否定、引用、限定条件和上下文影响判断。

rules.title_zh: 降解宣称的证据与条件
rules.repair: 缺证据时建议移除，或补充适用商品、测试条件和范围后人工审阅。
rules.note: 不从棉质推导降解条件；不将风险提示当作最终法律结论。召回词表含 compostable 与 bio/photo/hydro/oxo 前缀的 degradable（260.7、260.8）；报告里定位到命中的那个词，不是整句。

rules.title_zh: 客观性能或认证宣称依据
rules.repair: 指出缺少何种证据，不补造认证，不把一般商品页当性能测试。
rules.note: 证据标准取决于宣称；本规则不实现特定认证体系的官方核验。认证印章（260.6）按名称召回：GREENGUARD / OEKO-TEX / GOTS / bluesign / FSC / Cradle to Cradle / certified —— 召回不等于证书有问题，交给人看证书。

rules.repair: 补充该宣称所需的科学证据并人工复核，或删除该宣称；不要用「抗菌」「防霉」「缓解疼痛」这类词当卖点。
rules.note: 召回三支：① 成品写法（antibacterial / antimicrobial / antifungal / antiseptic / sterile / sanitized / hypoallergenic / non-allergenic / allergy tested / medical grade / medical use / clinical proven / dermatologist recommended / FDA approved|registered|cleared / EPA registered）；② 名词式作用宣称，只认微生物对象 + proof|resistant|free|repellent|control（mildew proof / mold-resistant / dust mite resistant / germ-free …）；③ 疗效动词 + 身体或病菌宾语（relieve … pain、kills … bacteria、prevents … mold），中间允许 3 个词，`strains` 只认「肩/背/颈/关节/肌肉 + 劳损」。**不收**气味状态（odor-free / odor-resistant）、舒适度（skin-friendly / anti-fatigue）、防静电、食品接触——它们不是医疗宣称，本包也还没实现对应的性能宣称条目。本规则**不判断宣称真伪**，只提示这类词在美国属于需要实证支持的客观宣称；抗菌与抗霉在成品上还可能被当作农药类宣称管理（本包未收录该来源，故不做定性）。否定句按上下文排除。召回数字：`npm run probe:claims` 第三栏，第 16 轮 12/28 → 28/28。

rules.repair: 使用正确的属性和单位；缺失的性能值保持未知。
采用明确确认的零售件数，不沿用供应商装箱数量。
按字段、单位、商品版本关联记录来源；参数未知或冲突时补充对应资料或修改表述。模型漏引用不影响已关联参数；整句语义与复杂宣称仍需单独审阅。
拒绝假引用；重新检查，无法支持的结论标为待核。
列出未覆盖或失败项目，保留部分完成状态。

coverage_limits: 未取得正式商品类型 Schema；不检查完整商品属性、品牌资格、变体或商品准入。
未覆盖图片、A+、Search Terms、进口、税务、纺织品标签及各州全部要求。
Green Guides 的引用用于宣传风险预审，不宣称模型能完成法律认定。
商品事实和系统检查是补充，不单独用来计数赛题的两类校验。
本地英文长度边界已定义；尚未对接 Amazon 验证 Unicode 计数和字段提交行为。
促销语词表只收整短语、不穷举；Detail Page 公告里的「公司专属信息」与「另一个商品的细节」两类需要语义判断，本地层不做。
认证印章只按名称召回，不核验证书真伪或有效期。

content.title: Westford Mill W101 100% Cotton Tote Bag, 10 L, 38 x 42 cm
content.item_highlights: 100% cotton tote, 140 gsm (4.1 oz/yd²); 38 x 42 cm; 10 L capacity; 67 cm handles; CutAway label.

bullet_points.text: 100% cotton fabric at 140 gsm (4.1 oz/yd²), a plain-woven tote for everyday errands, shopping and carrying daily items.
Measures 38 x 42 cm (width x height) with a 10 liter capacity, giving you room for groceries, books or a change of clothes.
67 cm handles let you carry the bag by hand or over the shoulder.
CutAway label for ease of rebranding, useful if you print or embroider the bag for a shop, event or team.
Westford Mill W101 cotton tote bag; color and retail pack quantity are not confirmed for this listing.

content.description: The Westford Mill W101 is a tote bag made from 100% cotton fabric at 140 gsm (4.1 oz/yd²). It measures 38 x 42 cm (width x height) and holds 10 liters, so it suits everyday carrying such as groceries, books or a change of clothes. The 67 cm handles let you carry it by hand or over the shoulder. A CutAway label makes the bag easier to rebrand if you plan to print or embroider it for a shop, event or team. Color and retail pack quantity are not confirmed for this listing.
